name: @moreflow/forms
description: Headless public-form helpers with an optional browser Turnstile mount.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --external:libphonenumber-js --external:@moreflow/tracking --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MoreflowForms --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/browser.js && tsc --singleThreaded -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run build
